prompt:
Summarise the supplied source text in at most 100 words. Be concise and objective.
Report only information supported by the source. Attribute claims, opinions, and

summary: Suncor CEO Steve Williams predicts oilsands production will continue for another century, despite environmental and Indigenous opposition. He says technological advances have reduced costs and emissions, and expects smaller projects to replace major new mines. Suncor has proposed 10 projects at existing reserves, each costing roughly $2 billion and producing 30,000–40,000 barrels daily. Analyst Jackie Forrest expects incremental investment but not a return to 2014 levels. Greenpeace campaigner Mike Hudema disputes Williams’s outlook, calling the oilsands an environmental disaster and arguing that continued production would signal a failure to protect the planet.
